subtitle: Lesson 76 · Backup & Restore

eyebrow: Relative to the last full, not the last diff
code:
Sun 2am: FULL           <- base of the chain
Mon 2am: DIFF            (everything since Sunday's full)
Mon-Fri, hourly: LOG     (every transaction since the last log)

Restore = FULL + latest DIFF + every LOG since, in order
caption: Skip one log backup in the middle, and the chain breaks.

steps.label: Full
steps.sub: Every page in the database, right now

steps.label: Differential
steps.sub: Pages changed since the LAST FULL — not the last diff

steps.label: Log
steps.sub: Every transaction since the last log — enables point-in-time recovery
